say:1:1013128001:0.text: Is Marilee's home around here? When visiting a lady's residence, one's gotta be polite.
say:1:1013128001:0.source_cn: 梅瑞特小姐的家，就在这里吗？拜访女性的住所，看来我得保...

say:3:1013128002:0.text: Sis brought home a strange boy! This has never happened before, could it be...?
say:3:1013128002:0.source_cn: 姐姐带了陌生的男孩子回来了！从来没有这种事，难道……

say:4:1013128003:0.text: I see! He's the bear sis caught and mercifully released, and now he's turned into a human to repay her!
say:4:1013128003:0.source_cn: 我知道了！他是被姐姐射中又放走的小棕熊，现在变成人形来...

say:5:1013128004:1.text: ... Wait, why a bear? I could definitely be a cooler animal!
say:5:1013128004:1.source_cn: ……等等，为什么是小棕熊？没有更帅气的动物吗？

say:7:1013128005:0.text: Gosh! You two, stop teasing my guests. Where are Grandpa and Grandma?
say:7:1013128005:0.source_cn: 喂！你们两个，别闹我的客人们。爷爷奶奶呢？

say:8:1013128006:0.text: The street lamp broke earlier! Grandpa's fixing it and Grandma's holding the ladder...
say:8:1013128006:0.source_cn: 之前后面的路灯坏掉了，爷爷去修灯了，奶奶给他扶梯子……
